title: gymnogramma rufa
intro: Gymnogramma rufa, commonly known as the Red Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Compositae. It is a flowering plant native to various parts of the world, including Africa and Asia. The health benefits of Gymnogramma rufa include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gymnogramma rufa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
